shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
The weather today is quite nice and sunny.
My favorite food is pizza with extra cheese.
I like to go for walks in the park every day.
Traveling to new places is always exciting for me.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
I often watch movies with my friends on weekends.
Cooking new recipes is a hobby that I really enjoy.
I believe that learning a new language can be very rewarding.
Spending time with family is important for maintaining strong connections.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you have taken?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel travel impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.

Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in maintaining your workout routine?
Q3: What is your opinion on the importance of regular exercise?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone starting to exercise?
